notes.title: Game Version Update 0.61
notes.content:
We've uploaded a new build! The current patch v0.61 is the beginning of our vertical slice. We know, we know- it's a little rough around the edges and has some things we will continue to work on. Thanks for your patience! ːsteamhappyː

Update: It was brought to our attention that the build doesn't work through Steam, however you should be able to launch the game by locating the MidnightCipher.exe in the common files. You may also need to tweak your settings- it's not perfectly optimized just yet!
